children.text: The applicant must be a resident of Bihar.
The applicant must be an unmarried girl.
She must have passed the intermediate examination from a recognized school, madrasa, or institution in Bihar.
The examination must have been conducted in 2021 or later.
The applicant must have a valid bank account.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
- The applicant must be a resident of Bihar.
- The applicant must be an unmarried girl.
- She must have passed the intermediate examination from a recognized school, madrasa, or institution in Bihar.
- The examination must have been conducted in 2021 or later.
- The applicant must have a valid bank account.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The Mukhyamantri Balika (Intermediate Pass) Protsahan Yojana is a scheme by the Bihar government aimed at promoting girl child education, curbing child marriages, reducing fertility rates, and empowering girls to become self-reliant.

children.text: The "Mukhyamantri Balika (Intermediate Pass) Protsahan Yojana", a component of the "Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana", launched by the Education Department, Bihar, focuses on the socio-economic upliftment of girls in Bihar. The scheme provides monetary incentives to unmarried girls who have cleared their intermediate examinations from recognized schools or madrasas within Bihar.
